nodes.label: Todo Fixes for Complete Functionality of Project
nodes.rationale: Tracks bugs, gaps and pending decisions so an incomplete or buggy product is not shipped to stakeholders. All previously tracked bugs have been implemented; the list now holds only open decisions and gaps identified since.
nodes.norm_label: todo fixes for complete functionality of project

nodes.label: Open Items
nodes.rationale: Section reserved for decisions and gaps discovered after the original bug backlog was cleared, keeping resolved work out of the active list.

nodes.label: Admin App View vs User App View Decision
nodes.rationale: Unresolved product decision: the app must commit to either an administrator-facing view or an end-user-facing view, which in turn determines what permission gating the UI needs.
nodes.norm_label: admin app view vs user app view decision

nodes.label: Earthquake Simulation
nodes.rationale: Open decision on whether to keep the existing simulation as-is or invest in upgrading it; deferred rather than dropped because it is a core feature of the experience.

nodes.label: Missing science-building 1st Floor Floorplan Asset
nodes.rationale: The floor model mapping resolves to an SVG path that does not exist on disk, so the first floor of science-building cannot render.

nodes.label: Building Floorplan Mapping
nodes.rationale: Mechanism associating a building and floor with an SVG floorplan asset; it is the shared point of failure behind all three floorplan gaps listed.

nodes.label: Incorrect social-sciences Floorplan Mapping
nodes.rationale: The mapping points at another building's SVGs, so the wrong floorplan renders silently instead of failing loudly.

nodes.label: Missing up-high-school Floorplan Mapping
nodes.rationale: No floorplan mapping entry exists at all for up-high-school, leaving the building without any floor view.

nodes.label: Hardcoded Administrator Role Label
nodes.rationale: The settings page displays Administrator as static text rather than deriving it from stored role data, so the label implies authority the system does not actually enforce.

nodes.label: Role and Permission System
nodes.rationale: Identified as absent: there is no real backing role/permission model, which is why the UI role label is only cosmetic and why the admin-vs-user view decision is still open.
